description: Netflix, Amazon Prime Lite and JioHotstar Super offer different ways to keep streaming costs down while retaining television access. Basic costs Rs. 199 monthly and streams in 720p without ads. Prime Lite costs Rs. 799 yearly, with HD video and ads, but limits viewing to one registered device. JioHotstar Super costs Rs. 1,099 annually, supports two simultaneous devices and offers up to Full HD. Annual billing makes a notable difference to JioHotstar's cost. The plans also differ in content and additional benefits.
title: Netflix vs Prime Video vs JioHotstar: Cheapest Plans for Watching on TV

description: If you’re in the market looking for a laptop for coding in college, then there are several factors to consider. The decision involves more than picking a processor with a high clock speed. Students need enough RAM to run an IDE (Integrated Development Environment), browser tabs and development tools together, along with SSD storage for projects and software. A comfortable keyboard and a display with enough room for code are also useful, particularly during long study sessions.
title: Best Laptops for Coding for College Students Under Rs. 80,000
